opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's priority questions, demonstrate relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience, and value for money.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, are encouraged to apply.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.
